resources.name: aihappey-chat
resources.title: aihappey Chat UI
resources.description: Frontend chat application for aihappey. Provides a clean, model-agnostic chat UI with streaming, tool calls, provider selection, and MCP-compatible interactions.

resources.name: aihappey-ai
resources.title: aihappey Core AI backend
resources.description: Central AI backend powering aihappey. Implements provider-agnostic inference, OpenAI-compatible APIs, Vercel AI SDK endpoints, streaming, reranking, image, speech, and tool execution.

resources.name: aihappey-mcp
resources.title: aihappey MCP servers
resources.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers exposing structured resources, prompts, and tools for aihappey. Enables AI-native integrations instead of ad-hoc AI features.

resources.name: aihappey-agents
resources.title: aihappey Agent runtime
resources.description: Agent implementations built on top of MCP and the aihappey backend. Focused on task execution, tool orchestration, and long-running agentic workflows.

resources.name: aihappey-windows
resources.title: aihappey Windows
resources.description: Native Windows AI client built with WinUI 3. Multi-provider chat, agents, MCP tools, resources and prompts, Skills and human-in-the-loop workflows.

resources.name: aihappey-providers
resources.title: aihappey Providers
resources.description: Reusable .NET AI provider implementations and shared metadata for 600+ providers. Supports native APIs, model catalogs, pricing, inference, streaming, tool calling, speech, images and video.

resources.name: aihappey-chat
resources.title: aihappey Chat UI
resources.description: Browser-based multi-provider AI chat client supporting streaming, agents, MCP tools, resources, prompts, Skills, Plugins, model switching and rich interactive responses.

resources.name: aihappey-ai
resources.title: aihappey AI Gateway
resources.description: Stateless multi-provider .NET AI gateway exposing normalized APIs for chat, responses, messages, models, tools, agents, MCP, images, audio, video, embeddings and reranking.

resources.name: aihappey-mcp
resources.title: aihappey MCP Backend
resources.description: Model Context Protocol backend hosting AI and business integrations with tools, resources, prompts, server discovery, authentication and reusable integration infrastructure.

resources.name: aihappey-agents
resources.title: aihappey Agent Runtime
resources.description: Multi-agent runtime built on Microsoft Agent Framework with YAML and JSON agents, MCP, Skills, Plugins, sequential, concurrent, handoff, group chat, Magentic and Decisions workflows.

resources.name: aihappey-windows
resources.title: aihappey Native Windows Client
resources.description: Native WinUI 3 AI application supporting multi-provider chat, agents, local and remote runtimes, MCP, Skills, native tools, human-in-the-loop approvals, BYOK and Entra authentication.

resources.name: aihappey-providers
resources.title: aihappey Provider Implementations
resources.description: Reusable .NET AI provider implementations and shared JSON metadata for 600+ providers, covering native APIs, model catalogs, pricing, inference, streaming, tools, speech, images and video.
